name: B2B Lead Gen & Cold Outreach AI System

parameters.content:
### 🚀 Agent 1: Lead Hunter & Researcher (Apollo.io + Gemini Key 1)
1. Live search real registered companies via Apollo.io database
2. Gemini analyzes their actual business & diagnoses real tech bottlenecks (Next.js, Stripe, n8n AI Automation)
3. Appends 100% real leads into Google Sheets **'Leads'** tab with Status = 'New'

### ✍️ Agent 2: Cold Email Drafter (Gemini Key 2)
1. Reads leads where Status = 'New'
2. Writes personalized cold email + 4-day follow-up following company rules (Max 100 words, Next.js / Stripe / AI Automation value prop, Moshiur sign-off)
3. Appends to **'Email Drafts'** tab with Approved? = 'No'
4. Updates Lead status to 'Draft Created'

### 🛡️ Human-in-the-Loop Email Dispatcher
1. Reads **'Email Drafts'** where Approved? = 'Yes' and Sent Date is empty
2. Sends email safely via Gmail / SMTP
3. Stamps 'Sent Date' in Email Drafts
4. Updates **'Leads'** tab Status = 'Email Sent', Last Contacted = Today, Next Action = 'Follow-up in 4 days'
